title: Pure Cyber Angel
summary: Cyber Angel cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Cyber Angel is a LIGHT Fairy Ritual deck. Cyber Petit Angel searches a Cyber Angel monster or Machine Angel Ritual, and Cyber Egg Angel, from the 2019 wave, searches any Machine Angel Spell. Machine Angel Ritual summons any Cyber Angel, then protects a LIGHT monster from the GY. Cyber Angel Benten searches a LIGHT Fairy when tributed, so it is the usual Ritual tribute, and Cyber Angel Idaten fetches a Ritual Spell when summoned. Cyber Angel Dakini makes them send a monster to the GY and recovers a Ritual card every End Phase. Cyber Angel Izana, the newest Ritual (2019), makes them send a Spell/Trap away and destroys a card when they target it. The other 2019 Spells tribute a Cyber Angel for value. Merciful Machine Angel draws two, and Incarnated Machine Angel summons a fresh Cyber Angel from the hand when you take damage.
